changes.financialBeforeAfter: Original six-row before snapshot preserved. If one bounded server read succeeds, store its after snapshot and equality fingerprints; failure or deadline is explicitly UNAVAILABLE, and changed data is marked false. Neither converts HOLD to PASS.

changes.lateRecovery: Even a ready predicate observed during diagnostic capture remains HOLD. No rerun of the acceptance stage.
